draft.subject: Following up on your Slack integration ticket
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for flagging the Slack integration page spinning — your ticket is still open and I'm staying on it until we have an answer for you.

In the meantime, I don't want setup to stall. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project with your actual tasks is the step that makes everything else click.

Would a short call this week work? I'll walk through that first project with you and chase the Slack issue in parallel.

Best,
Chidi
